messages:
alert-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT hosted-usw2 gpu-pool 'g4-large' p95 queueing >120s for 12m; queue_length=320; current_admission=0.72. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/hosts/usw2-gpu-pool
rachel: saw it, looks like a big burst from multiple PLG tenants — embeddings + short chat requests spiking at once
samir: autoscaler status? any provisioning failures or quota hits?
autoscaler-bot: scale-up request blocked: max_on_demand_ratio reached for region=usw2; pending_request_count=18; estimated_provision_time=6m
len: I can push a temporary routing policy to divert low-priority traffic to euw1. also can bump admission headroom from 0.72 -> 0.85 as a short-term mitigation
kevin: is this correlated with the new quantized-2 model rollout earlier? I saw increased CPU on frontend proxies
andrea: logs for the gpu workers show lots of tiny 1-3 token requests causing scheduling overhead, not model slowdown. request size histogram attached in dashboard (see link)
rachel: ok -- plan: 1) enable best-effort routing to euw1 for tenant tag "plg-noncritical" 2) bump admission headroom to 0.85 3) enable request_coalescing for small payloads on the proxy for 10m
samir: agree. also check evictions: if eviction_rate climbs, we should reduce eviction aggressiveness to keep nodes stable
len: applying routing rule now (command):

```
POST /internal/routing/policies
{ "match": "tenant:plg-noncritical", "route": "hosted-euw1", "priority": 70 }
```
len: bumping admission headroom to 0.85 via admctl

```
admctl set headroom --pool=hosted-usw2 --value=0.85
```
autoscaler-bot: scale request queued; provisioning will continue once on-demand quota frees up; note: GPU supplier ETA ~8m for capacity orders
kevin: I also paused the model rollout for quantized-2 on hosted for now :thumbsup:
andrea: turned on proxy request_coalescing for payloads <= 512 bytes for 15m
rachel: monitoring... current queue_length=210, p95=92s, p50=18s
samir: looks like the routing change helped shave off a chunk. if p95 stays >60s we should start a partial capacity reassign (move 2 nodes from burst pool)
len: initiated node move request: `node-manager migrate --from=burst-reserve --to=hosted-usw2 --count=2`
alert-bot: note: admission_surge_metric still elevated but trending down; next alert if p95>120s persists 10m
rachel: good news — 18:08: queue_length=14, p95=34s, admission=0.86. reverting proxy coalescing to default after 5m window
andrea: confirming worker CPU/GRPC latencies normalized
samir: follow-up action items: 1) add a short-term runbook for multi-tenant embedding storms 2) evaluate increasing on_demand_ratio for usw2 3) enable smarter small-request batching on the proxy as a permanent opt-in
kevin: filing infra ticket to review quota with supplier and request prioritized on-demand pool for usw2
rachel: closing this thread — metrics stable. thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
alert-bot: ALERT RESOLVED: hosted-usw2 gpu-pool p95 back within threshold.
